abstract: To evaluate the treatment-related late sequelae including gonadal function and second malignancy 94 patients with stage I and II testicular seminoma treated with postorchiectomy radiation therapy were analyzed retrospectively. The 10-year cause specific, disease free and actuarial survival rates were 100, 98.5 and 96.1% for stage II and 91.7, 83.3 and 91.7% for stage II, respectively. The most common late sequelae of gastrointestinal tract was peptic ulcer, developing in 16% of all patients with a median interval of 12 months, but severity was mild except one who needed subtotal gastrectomy. Second malignancies developed in 9 patients (9.5%) with a median interval of 13 years, but calculated O/E ratio excluding 2 patients with secondary germ cell tumor of contralateral testis was 2.3 and did not reach a significant level statistically. Concerning gonadal function assessed from the number of the children, 79% of the patients who wanted to have children after the treatment were successful in fathering children. No fatal complications were observed.
abstract_ja: 治療関連の晩期合併症(性腺機能や二次悪性腫瘍を含む)を評価するため、精巣摘除後放射線療法を受けた病期Iおよび病期IIの精巣セミノーマ94例を後方視的に解析した。10年時の疾患特異的生存率、無病生存率、生命表による生存率は、病期IIで100%、98.5%、96.1%、病期IIで91.7%、83.3%、91.7%であった。消化管の晩期合併症として最も多かったのは消化性潰瘍で、全患者の16%に中央値12か月で発症した。重症度は軽度であったが、1例のみ亜全胃切除を要した。二次がんは9例(9.5%)に発生し、中央値13年で出現した。対側精巣に生じた続発性胚細胞腫瘍の2例を除外して算出した観察数/期待数(O/E)比は2.3であり、統計学的に有意水準には達しなかった。生殖腺機能については、子どもを希望した患者のうち79%が父親となった。致命的な合併症は認められなかった。
